ev.q: Only 3% of respondents said dismissal was a major problem
In most cases (58%), dismissal lasted ≤3 days.
Approximately 20% of parents reported that an adult in the household missed work
90% of parents agreed with the dismissal decision
The most commonly reported consequences faced by parents and families included missed work (20%)
conducted a randomized telephone poll of 523 parents from 39 states

methods_quotes.q: Data were weighted to match the U.S. Census by sex, age, race, education, number of children in household, and home ownership
and by metropolitan area status according to the telephone exchange report
